claims.claim: The loader no longer hard-codes trust to false; it consults the reload-provided trust resolver exactly once and awaits it before applying the decision.
The resolver observes the untrusted bootstrap result loaded by loadProjectTrustExtensions (user/CLI extensions only, no project resources).
A true decision allows project resources (project extension is loaded after the decision); a false decision denies them (project extension stays out).
TASK.md requires the repaired source, a standalone .prale-eval/regression.mjs that exits zero when fixed and asserts on the original fault, and this result file.

validation.notes: The only source change is the trust resolution in DefaultResourceLoader.reload: `const projectTrusted = false;` became `const projectTrusted = await options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions });`, so the resolver runs once, receives the untrusted bootstrap LoadExtensionsResult, is awaited (the reload pauses while its promise is pending), and its boolean result is passed to settingsManager.setProjectTrusted before settings/package resources are re-resolved. .prale-eval/regression.mjs loads the real resource-loader.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createTrustSubject (boundary fakes only) and asserts: resolver called exactly once in both decisions; it observes state.trusted=false with only cli.ts and user.ts in the bootstrap result (no project.ts); no settings/resolve/extensions event occurs between resolver-enter and resolver-exit (async ordering preserved); after a true decision the settings manager receives true and package resolution observes true, the final extension set is [cli.ts, project.ts, user.ts] (project resources allowed) and user.ts is loaded only once (pre-trust result reused); after a false decision the final set stays [cli.ts, user.ts] and no trusted resolution ever happens (project resources denied). Verified both directions by temporarily reverting the one-line fix: the regression then fails with `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: the reload must call the trust resolver exactly once (0 !== 1)`, and a fire-and-forget resolver variant fails with an ordering assertion, so it is not a printed-success script. Optional repo test suite (vitest) could not be run because no node_modules are installed in this workspace and dependencies must not be installed; the standalone Node 24 regression is the focused validation and exits 0.
